coverage.method: Sitemap/navigation discovery, page-family HTML/CSS inspection, selected browser screenshots and runtime probes where permitted.
coverage.viewports: 1440px desktop and 390px mobile; not every source page was rendered.
coverage.limits: Public page families sampled, not every article, locale, private app or interaction state. Source-only theme/motion declarations are not runtime verification.

color.palette_type: warm paper monochrome — greige/cream neutrals with ink text; one reserved chartreuse CTA yellow, indigo links, and a small set of muted callout hues
color.cta_yellow: #fbff81: full highlighter bands behind hero/Pricing titles, small marker swipes on labels, and hand-drawn SVG accents.

surfaces_light.note: Outer page/community rail uses #edede8; main paper panel #f6f6f3; inset #e5e5e1; code #333.

lines_light.note: hairline greige borders (line-structure) do almost all separation; hover/focus promotes borders to the dark line-cta ink; dashed dividers (border-dashed border-line-divider-dash) confirmed on /careers — dashed underlines beneath f37Analog small labels and mono captions, plus tall vertical dashed rules (h-48/h-72 w-px) between columns

callouts.note: muted, slightly desaturated set — periwinkle info instead of blue; plus data-viz accents --muted-green (hsl 84 81% 44%), --muted-magenta (330 90% 70%), --muted-blue (239 84% 67%)

color.code_syntax: on dark #333 code surfaces: orange #c17e2e, pink #d05376, blue #438aa5, secondary text #fffcf280 (translucent cream)

dark_mode.note: dark theme keeps the warm cast (greenish-brown blacks #171714, not neutral gray); CTA yellow darkens to olive #4c4d23; beige accent stays #f1ede1

color.shadcn_layer: a standard shadcn/ui HSL token layer (--background/--foreground/--muted/--destructive etc.) coexists with the custom surface/line/text tokens; --radius is 0.5rem for shadcn components but marketing UI overrides to 2px
color.contrast_strategy: soft-contrast warm ink-on-paper (#222220 on #f6f6f3) rather than pure black-on-white; hierarchy via 4-step text scale (primary/secondary/tertiary/disabled) and surface stepping, color reserved for links, callouts, and code

typography.fonts: F37 Analog (CSS f37Analog) for display; Inter for body/UI; monospace for labels and keycaps.
typography.marketing: Home h1 68/71.4, weight 500; mobile h1 44px. Section h2 32/36.8; closing statement 50/50. Pricing h1 50/50.
typography.controls: Hero button 16px, not the 12px compact token; labels and community metrics use smaller mono styles.

spacing.content_density: compact-comfortable — 13px UI type, 26–32px control heights, tight gaps (6px icon gaps)
spacing.section_rhythm: homepage is a continuous ruled document: sections separated by hairline line-structure borders rather than large empty bands; denser than typical dev-tool marketing

layout.frame: Desktop left community rail ~240px plus centered main paper column; large marketing content width ~840px.
layout.spacing: Hero section about 60px vertical padding, later sections about 120px; hatch gutters and corner brackets define the sheet.
layout.mobile: Community rail disappears; search/hamburger header, centered 44px headline, stacked panels.
layout.docs: Top categories, left navigation, main prose, right TOC; active nav uses a hatch fill; breadcrumb and Copy page split button.

shape.radius_scale: 2px nearly everywhere (rounded-[2px]) — buttons, cards, keycaps, code frames; rounded-full only for avatars/dots; shadcn --radius 0.5rem exists but marketing overrides it
shape.border_usage: constant 1px hairlines in line-structure #cfcfc9; borders are the primary structural device (cells, buttons, keycaps, logo grids); dashed divider token (#bebeb6) for secondary separation
shape.divider_style: solid hairlines for structure; dashed #bebeb6 lines for annotation-level separation (underlines under captions, vertical rules between figure columns) — dashed reads as 'pencil markup' on top of the printed document
shape.rule: near-square corners + visible hairline rules = technical-document look; avoid pill shapes entirely

elevation.shadow_style: very soft, small, layered: buttons/cards use [box-shadow:0_4px_8px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.05),0_4px_4px_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)]; hierarchy mostly from surface stepping (#f6f6f3 → #edede8 → #e5e5e1) and borders, not depth
elevation.depth_cues: surface tone + hairlines first, whisper shadows second; no glass, no glow

iconography.style: Lucide stroke icons at small sizes; large third-party integration logos as flat SVGs in ruled grid cells

motion.easing_durations: transition-colors at 150/180/200ms for most state changes; 700ms for slow reveals
motion.keyframes_observed: marquee / marquee-left / marquee-right / marquee-vertical (stat + logo loops), border-beam (animated border highlight), accordion-down/up, ask-ai-open/close, rive-text-in, tooltip-in, ellipsis, fall, grid, slide, spin-custom
motion.philosophy: Functional micro-motion, marquees and bounded Rive/DOM demonstrations; sampled pages do not establish library absence across the whole site.

components.buttons: Compact rectangular 2px-radius primary ink button, cream label and separate square keycap; hero label 16px, total height ~32px, asymmetric padding 3px 3px 3px 10px. Secondary paper fill, #cfcfc9 border and soft layered shadow.
components.pricing: Four adjacent outlined plan panels with bracket corners, small dark badges and comparison rows beneath.
components.navigation: Desktop community statistics are in the LEFT rail; docs add a conventional left nav and right TOC.
components.cards: Printed-paper borders, hatch accents and annotation marks; avoid glossy gradients or oversized rounding.
components.code: Dark #333 code panels with warm text, filename/language label and copy control.

design_style.mood: Printed engineering notebook: warm paper, ink, chartreuse highlighter and precisely drawn annotations.
design_style.composition: Left community rail and centered paper column on marketing pages; hatch strips and corner brackets group sections. Hero typography is a large highlighted statement.
design_style.imagery: Rive/DOM product demonstrations, interface captures and logo marquees; visual activity stays within framed demonstrations.
design_style.voice: Developer-oriented, evidence-led, with mono labels and keyboard affordances.

visual_effects.technology: Homepage has one Rive canvas and DOM/CSS animation; a loop-enabled in-app-agent MP4 is also present but not autoplaying in the observed DOM.
visual_effects.highlighter: Chartreuse bands span complete headline lines on home and pricing; small label marker swipes are a separate treatment.
visual_effects.motion: Logo marquees 40s left / 48s right, linear infinite; rive-text-in 200ms with 50ms stagger; section opacity/transform transitions around 700ms.
visual_effects.surface: Static diagonal hatching, 1px rules and bracket corners supply texture without a particle scene.
visual_effects.scope: Canvas counts and video behavior are homepage observations; dark token definitions are source-only in this refresh, not a verified live theme.

page_families./: Highlighted hero, left community statistics, Rive demonstration and two-direction logo strips.
page_families./pricing: 50px headline, four plan columns, dense comparison table.
page_families./docs/observability/overview; /docs/prom: Documentation shell, copy controls, code, callouts and TOC.
page_families./blog; /changelog; /customers; /enterpri: Editorial, dated release, customer-proof and enterprise variants checked through source; shared paper/ink tokens.
